title: 2026 Senate: a state-level regression forecast
text:
WarningSynthetic data



Every number and figure on this page comes from simulated survey, census and election inputs with a known structure (scripts/00b-simulate_regression_inputs.py). They show that the pipeline works end to end. They say nothing about the real 2026 races. Set SOURCE = "real" in this page’s first code chunk once the real data are in place.
